acceptanceCriteria: Teardown failures are attributed by location like other test failures (as V1-2373/2374 do for the body).
A fixture with a failing teardown is classified correctly; the test fails before the fix.
body: Residual from lane cce-1022k (PR beamfall/corvint#1546, seal 1aa0691af). A failure raised in test teardown is classified as infrastructure, so a real product or test defect surfacing in teardown is hidden from the discrimination verdict.
